title: MXL - Flow replication
description: Replication sessions of one MXL flow: throughput, loss, media age and worker health, from the replicator.

list.name: flow
list.label: Flow

query.query: query_result(max by (flow_id, name) (label_join(mxl_flow_metadata{flow_data_type=~"$data_type"}, "name", " · ", "flow_group_name", "flow_data_type")) and on(flow_id) group by (flow_id) (mxl_grains_total))

list.definition: query_result(max by (flow_id, name) (label_join(mxl_flow_metadata{flow_data_type=~"$data_type"}, "name", " · ", "flow_group_name", "flow_data_type")) and on(flow_id) group by (flow_id) (mxl_grains_total))

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Replication sessions carrying this flow. Each session copies the flow from one node to another.

targets.expr: count(group by (session) (mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Received by all targets over 5 minutes. Video uses the on-wire estimate (grain plus a 4 KiB header), audio is samples × channels × 4 B.

targets.expr:
sum(rate(mxl_payload_octets_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", format="video"}[5m])
   or rate(mxl_octets_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", format="audio"}[5m])
      * on(flow_id, node) group_left() max by (flow_id, node) (mxl_flow_channels_total) * 4) * 8

panels.title: Worst loss
panels.description: Highest share of media a target did not receive over 5 minutes. Audio counts samples, video counts grains.

targets.expr: max(rate(mxl_grains_lost{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}[5m]) / (rate(mxl_grains_lost{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}[5m]) + (rate(mxl_octets_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", format="audio"}[5m]) or rate(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", format="video"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Worst arrival age p99
panels.description: Age of the media when it reaches the target, p99 of the worst session.

targets.expr: max((mxl_source_latency_ns{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", quantile="0.99"} >= 0) / 1e6)

panels.title: Worst network p99
panels.description: Receive time minus the transmit timestamp the initiator writes into the grain.

targets.expr: max((mxl_network_latency_ns{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", quantile="0.99"} >= 0) / 1e6 > 0)

panels.title: Worker restarts (1h)
panels.description: Initiator and target worker restarts for this flow in the last hour.

targets.expr: sum(increase(mxl_worker_restarts{flow_id="$flow"}[1h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: One row per session, over the last 5 minutes. Sent and Received are grains per second, sample batches for audio. The initiator does not count audio yet, so Sent and Age at source stay empty for audio flows. Ages and network latency are p50. Source written: the source flow's head advances. Replica written / read: the target writes the replica, and something reads it. Restarts counts both workers since their agents started. Domains of both ends are on the Flow dashboard.

targets.expr:
max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  (rate(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}[5m]) and mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"} > 0)
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  (rate(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}[5m]))
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  (rate(mxl_payload_octets_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", format="video"}[5m])
   or rate(mxl_octets_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", format="audio"}[5m])
      * on(flow_id, node) group_left() max by (flow_id, node) (mxl_flow_channels_total) * 4)
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))) * 8

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  (rate(mxl_grains_lost{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}[5m]) / (rate(mxl_grains_lost{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}[5m]) + (rate(mxl_octets_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", format="audio"}[5m]) or rate(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", format="video"}[5m]))))
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  ((mxl_source_latency_ns{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator", quantile="0.5"} >= 0) / 1e6)
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  ((mxl_source_latency_ns{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", quantile="0.5"} >= 0) / 1e6)
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  ((mxl_network_latency_ns{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", quantile="0.5"} >= 0) / 1e6 > 0)
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  (mxl_writer_active{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"})
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  (mxl_writer_active{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"})
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  (mxl_reader_active{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"})
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  (sum by (session) (mxl_worker_restarts{flow_id="$flow"}))
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

panels.title: Grains per second
panels.description: Grains read from the source by the initiator, and written to the replica by the target. Audio counts sample batches; the initiator does not count audio yet.

targets.expr:
max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  (rate(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}[$__rate_interval]) and mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"} > 0)
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  (rate(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}[$__rate_interval]))
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Received by the target. Video uses the on-wire estimate (grain plus a 4 KiB header), audio is samples × channels × 4 B.

targets.expr:
max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  (rate(mxl_payload_octets_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", format="video"}[$__rate_interval])
   or rate(mxl_octets_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", format="audio"}[$__rate_interval])
      * on(flow_id, node) group_left() max by (flow_id, node) (mxl_flow_channels_total) * 4)
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))) * 8

panels.title: Loss
panels.description: Share of media the target did not receive: an index gap between consecutive grains or sample batches. Audio counts samples, video counts grains.

targets.expr:
max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  (rate(mxl_grains_lost{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(mxl_grains_lost{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}[$__rate_interval]) + (rate(mxl_octets_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", format="audio"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", format="video"}[$__rate_interval]))))
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

panels.title: Worker restarts
panels.description: Worker restarts per interval, by session and endpoint.

targets.expr:
max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain, direction) (
  (increase(mxl_worker_restarts{flow_id="$flow"}[$__interval]))
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

panels.title: Media age (p50)
panels.description: Age of the media when the initiator reads it from the source flow, and when it reaches the target. The difference is the transfer time.

targets.expr:
max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  ((mxl_source_latency_ns{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator", quantile="0.5"} >= 0) / 1e6)
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (
  ((mxl_source_latency_ns{flow_id="$flow", direction="target", quantile="0.5"} >= 0) / 1e6)
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

panels.title: Media age (p99)
panels.description: As Media age (p50), at the 99th percentile.

targets.expr:
max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (

  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (

panels.description: Receive time minus the transmit timestamp the initiator writes into the grain.

targets.expr:
max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (

  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

defaults.noValue: Only video carries a transmit timestamp

panels.title: Activity
panels.description: Source written: the source flow's head advances. Replica written: the target writes the replica. Replica read: something reads the replica. The replicator's flags are hysteretic and coarse.

  (mxl_writer_active{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"})
  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))

  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))

max by (session, src, dst, src_domain, dst_domain) (

  * on(session) group_left(src, src_domain) group by (session, src, src_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="initiator"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "src_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)"))
  * on(session) group_left(dst, dst_domain) group by (session, dst, dst_domain) (label_replace(label_replace(mxl_grains_total{flow_id="$flow", direction="target"}, "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "dst_domain", "$1", "domain", "shm/(.*)")))
